verdict.rationale: Testing reactive state and logic in isolation is a fair question for a UI library, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents a way to unit test React state or hooks without a DOM, such as a test renderer or hook-testing utility. Server rendering, custom renderers and DevTools state inspection are adjacent features, not a documented DOM-free unit-testing capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can unit test my reactive state and logic without needing to render the DOM
